Maintain asset-register data including sites, devices, interfaces, IP address space, VLANs, Purdue level, zones, and conduits. What you’ll bring Experience and qualifications Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Communication Networks, or a similar field. 3–5 years’ experience in network or infrastructure operations, including at least 2 years in industrial, utility, or critical-infrastructure environments.
